bio: Victoria's second-highest peak at 1,922 m, with snow in its summit gullies until late spring and exposed routes.
A 37 km, three-day hike from Falls Creek to Mt Hotham past historic huts, with a permit needed to camp.
Exposed, relatively flat 11 km ridge from Diamantina Hut near Mt Hotham to the summit of Mount Feathertop.
Alpine resort with 85 ski trails in winter and a sightseeing chairlift, hiking, biking and a via ferrata in summer.
Alpine resort with about 60 km of cross-country trails, plus a summit loop walk and year-round camping.
Large reservoir on the Goulburn River for sailing, fishing and houseboats, with lookouts over the lake.
Short walk on Mount Stirling to the 1982 hut built as the set for The Man from Snowy River.

bio: A 14 km return walk to the 1,742 m summit through snow gum forest, passing the hut at Macalister Springs.
National park around Lake Eildon with swimming, sailing and fishing, plus Merlo Lookout and the Blowhard Summit walk.
Semi-remote state park with 360-degree summit views, Wild Dog Falls, 1920s logging kilns and free camping.
Reservoir behind a 1967 dam, popular for water-skiing in summer, with a boat ramp and coffee van at the north end.

bio: A 1.4 km, 30-minute loop around the dredge hole left by one of the world's largest electric dredges (1942-54).

Lake and parkland in Beechworth with a 2 km circuit and a bird hide, linked by a walk to Lake Kerferd.
Eucalypt forest park with a short walk to Mount Pilot Lookout's 360-degree views and the 8.5 km Whitebox track.
